ReportedBehavior: Typing into a connection field works only while the mouse button is held.
PrimaryCause: The body element has data-page and was included in a broad navigation selector. The bubbling click on mouse release called showPage and moved keyboard focus to the main workspace.
SecondaryCause: Snapshot rendering replaced unsaved connection inputs after focus left them.

Baseline.Isolation: Original published UI script was tested with the same new local host/backend to isolate the browser input behavior; this is not a complete v5.0.0 binary retest.
Baseline.FailedScenario: Normal mouse-release clicks keep settings and search fields focused for real keyboard input
Baseline.FailureMessage: Error: Folder input accepts keyboard typing after an ordinary released mouse click

ConnectionDraftChecks: Typed and pasted nonsecret drafts survive blur and an unrelated Diagnostics job snapshot
Same-scanner snapshot refresh retains the unsaved DOM password
Switching scanners clears the password but retains each scanner nonsecret draft
An actual Save click sends the currently visible draft; an invalid synthetic folder is rejected without scanner access

Scope: Synthetic local reports and typed password canaries only. No real scanner authentication, hospital access or physical keyboard/IME claim.
